title: Taxation
tagline: Learn income tax laws, planning, and return filing.
description: Taxation is one of the most in-demand practical skills in accounting and finance. This program builds hands-on filing skills — income tax returns, GST basics, and tax planning — so you can confidently handle real filings, not just the theory behind them.
outcomes: File individual and business income tax returns confidently
Apply tax-planning strategies within legal frameworks
Read and respond to tax notices and forms

topics: Income tax slabs & heads of income

projects: File a complete sample income tax return
Prepare a GST return for a sample business

faqs.q: Do I need an accounting background?
faqs.a: No — the program starts from tax fundamentals and builds up to full filings.

faqs.q: Is this useful if I want to file my own taxes, not work in the field?
faqs.a: Yes — many learners take this specifically to confidently handle their own or their family's filings.

faqs.q: What's the difference between Live and Self-Paced?
faqs.a: Live batches include instructor-led sessions, real-time doubt clearing, and mentorship. Self-Paced gives you the recorded content on your own schedule. Both include the same projects and certificate.
